_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score-anchored Disbelief with coil statistics and no clear breaker from vix/gold or flows makes HOLD the graded, high-base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst firmly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase so no direct conflict but no confirmation either
next_move.confirmed_if: vix stabilizes below spike territory and gold_strength fades while exchange net flows stop deteriorating
next_move.invalidated_if: vix >25 with gold_strength rising and broader exchange outflows accelerating
